summary: Isaacus offers a legal AI API. All new users receive $100 in free credits immediately upon adding a payment method to their Isaacus Platform account; the credits must be redeemed within two months. Startups can separately apply to the Isaacus Startup Program, and academics or non-profits may request additional credits.
claim_steps: Add a payment method to the account to receive the $100 in free credits
Use the credits within two months
